intro: Databases and platforms the group builds and runs for the research community.

products.name: CHAOS
products.full_name: Combinatorial High-throughput Analysis and Optimization for Synthesis
products.description: A first-principles database of high-entropy oxides with their ordered binary and ternary precursors and a library of structural and chemical descriptors. Bulk downloads by number of cations, a REST API, and Chaos-Agent, a natural-language interface to the data.

products.name: LOOP
products.description: A shared platform for high-entropy materials data: browse experimental, literature, and computational records, upload new results, run synthesizability predictions, and pull everything through an API with personal keys.

products.name: Fusion Mirror
products.description: Explore optical constants and normal-incidence Air/material reflectivity by wavelength and chemical family. Code-only preview: open an authorized local dataset in your browser; unpublished DFT data are not hosted here.
